name: College football Elo
metric: increase in holdout log loss when the component is neutralised

features.name: FCS opponent rating
features.detail: non-FBS opponents rated as average FBS

features.name: Margin of victory
features.detail: every win counts the same, whatever the margin

features.name: Conference regression
features.detail: regress to 1500 alone, ignoring the new conference

features.name: FBS entry rating
features.detail: a new FBS program starts at average

caveat: Neutralising a component changes every rating after it, so these are contributions to the whole replay, not to one game. 'Margin of victory' clamps the margin to a point rather than removing the multiplier, which also shrinks the update size.
